name: Get feature toggles
description: Call this when you need to retrieve the current set of feature flags enabled for the client in the Marketing Campaign module. To change these flags, use the action that updates the client configuration or consult the related documentation.

old-flow-migration.description: Whether the old flow migration feature is enabled.

plan-management-service.description: Whether the plan management service feature is enabled.

email-campaign-duplicate.description: Whether the email campaign duplicate feature is enabled.

new-campaign-dashboard.description: Whether the new campaign dashboard feature is enabled.

marketing-subject-ai-disabled.description: Whether the AI-generated marketing subject is disabled.

preview-on-email-clients.description: Whether preview on email clients is enabled.

editor-beta.description: Whether the editor beta feature is enabled.

email-campaigns-limit-disabled.description: Whether the email campaigns limit is disabled.

email-campaign-frequency-cap.description: Whether the email campaign frequency cap feature is enabled.

es-new-sender-domain.description: Whether the new sender domain feature for ES is enabled.

ent-users-push-experiment.description: Whether the enterprise users push experiment is enabled.

self-serve-users-push-experiment.description: Whether the self‑serve users push experiment is enabled.

duplicate-identifiers.description: Whether duplicate identifiers handling is enabled.

show-nova-agent.description: Whether the Nova agent is shown.

email-subject-alternate-use-ai-text.description: Whether alternate AI text for email subject is used.

editor-ai-subject-email-campaigns.description: Whether AI‑assisted subject editing for email campaigns is enabled.

multilingual-email-campaigns.description: Whether multilingual email campaigns are enabled.

new-conversions.description: Whether the new conversions feature is enabled.

mkt-editor-aigen.description: Whether the marketing editor AI generation feature is enabled.

mkt-editor-aigen-force-enable.description: Whether the marketing editor AI generation is forced enabled.

new-signup-flow.description: Whether the new signup flow is enabled.

seg-predictive-list.description: Whether predictive segment lists are enabled.
